newsitem.title: USA: U.S. soybean weekly export sales highlights--USDA.
newsitem.headline: U.S. soybean weekly export sales highlights--USDA.

text.p: USDA soybean export sales highlights in latest reporting week:
Net sales of 712,500 MT recovered from the previous week's marketing-year low and exceeded the 4-week average by three-fifths.

The major increases were for the Netherlands (202,800 MT), unknown destinations (72,700 MT), Germany (66,000 MT, includes 6,000 new sales, 60,000 destination changes), Mexico (65,600 MT), France (63,200 MT, includes 3,900 new sales, 59,200 destination changes), and Spain (60,900 MT, includes 800 new sales, 60,000 destination changes).

Exports of 597,900 MT were 8 percent above the previous week, but 24 percent under the 4-week average. The primary destinations were Japan (127,800 MT), Taiwan (75,600 MT), France (68,900 MT), and Germany (63,000 MT).
